correctness.rationale: For d+1 vertices in Euclidean unit ball, centered Gram-covariance identity (d!V)^2=(d+1)det(C) and trace bound give the unique regular simplex equality bound c_d. For t<=1/sqrt(d), the enclosing ellipsoid with horizontal squared semiaxis A=d(1-t^2)/(d-1) and vertical B=d t^2 contains K, and the difference A(1-z^2/B)-(1-z^2)=[(1-dt^2)/(d-1)](1-z^2/t^2)≥0. For odd d=2k+1, two orthogonal centered k-simplices on layers z=±t transform to regular unit sphere simplex, saturating the ellipsoid bound; equality and parity force balanced counts, and for t>=threshold the full-sphere regular simplex bound attains. Normalized t(1-t^2)^k/integral_0^t(1-s^2)^k ds strictly decreases by rescaling integration; for t>=threshold numerator constant and slab volume grows. Independently checked exact rational Gram determinants for d=3,5,7,9 and exact threshold identities. Finite checks supplement the global determinant argument.
